result.title: Decoupled Knowledge Retrieval and Compact Memory Enable Reliable Lifelong Model Editing
result.summary: Lifelong model editing requires continuously incorporating new facts into deployed large language models (LLMs) without expensive retraining or compromising existing capabilities. Memory-based editors offer an appealing solution by keeping the base parameters untouched, yet their practical use is hindered by linearly growing storage requirements and deteriorating retrieval performance as edits accumulate. To tackle these problems, we introduce BiSpace, a lifelong model editing framework that decouples memory retrieval from knowledge injection across two distinct representation spaces. BiSpace routes queries and identifies relevant edits in an external semantic space, while injecting the corresponding knowledge into the internal representation space of the LLM through sparse and storage-efficient updates. Extensive experiments show that BiSpace shrinks each entry's storage to only about 10.2% of the original and shows strong resilience to long edit sequences of up to 16K edits. On a more challenging benchmark, BiSpace further improves Overall Performance by more than 23% over existing methods. These results advance memory-based editing toward reliable long-term model maintenance at scale.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BiSpace 框架，将「查询路由与相关编辑检索」放在外部语义空间完成，再以稀疏、低存储的更新把知识写入 LLM 内部表示空间，使基于记忆的终身模型编辑在存储和长编辑序列（16K）下更稳定。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「外部语义空间检索 + 内部表示注入」的解耦与紧凑记忆，可能为 LVR 中按需检索/写入 latent 状态、控制证据筛选与记忆增长提供方法线索，但需核查是否可迁移到多模态推理状态。
